conditions.name: Type 2 diabetes
conditions.plain: Blood sugar runs high. Managed with metformin, walking, and diet.

conditions.name: Atrial fibrillation (AFib)
conditions.plain: Irregular heartbeat that raises stroke risk. Takes Eliquis, a blood thinner, to prevent clots.

conditions.name: Osteoarthritis, right knee
conditions.plain: Wear-and-tear knee pain. Tylenol as needed, physical therapy referral sent.

medications.name: Eliquis (apixaban)
medications.purpose: Blood thinner. Prevents stroke from AFib.
medications.howToTake: 1 tablet twice a day, about 12 hours apart, with or without food.
medications.notes: Do not skip doses. If a dose is missed, take it the same day as soon as remembered. Never take two doses at once.

medications.name: Metformin
medications.howToTake: 1 tablet with breakfast and 1 tablet with dinner.
medications.notes: Take with food to avoid an upset stomach.

medications.name: Lisinopril
medications.notes: Dose increased from 5 mg to 10 mg on March 10, 2026.

medications.name: Tylenol (acetaminophen)
medications.howToTake: 1 to 2 tablets every 6 hours if needed. Dr. Ruiz says no more than 3,000 mg in one day.
medications.notes: Use this instead of Advil, Motrin, or Aleve.

appointments.where: Pacific Heart Clinic, 4060 Fourth Ave, San Diego
appointments.prep: Arrive 15 minutes early. Bring your medication list. Ask about knee pain options that are safe with Eliquis. Ana is driving.

appointments.prep: No food after midnight. Water is fine. Take Eliquis as usual. Wait to take metformin until you eat after the draw.

AFib well controlled. Continue Eliquis 5 mg twice a day. Do not take ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin) or naproxen (Aleve) because they raise bleeding risk with Eliquis. Use Tylenol for pain. Blood pressure 132/78. Follow up in 3 months.
